title: When Do Foundation Models Pay Off for Retail Demand Forecasting? v1.12 TimesFM fev-bench WAPE Covariance Repair
description: v1.12 repair package for a PRISMA-informed exploratory cross-benchmark reanalysis of foundation models in retail demand forecasting. This version completes the official fev-bench retail WAPE prediction-level covariance repair for TimesFM 2.5, alongside Seasonal Naive, Chronos-Bolt-Tiny, Chronos-2, and TiRex across all 20 retail tasks. The package includes the manuscript PDF, LaTeX source, extraction/provenance tables, release audits, fev-bench WAPE covariance artifacts, Source B matched-panel artifacts, and replication code. SQL, MASE, GIFT-Eval, stronger best-baseline comparisons, GPU throughput, covariate-aware FM variants, and additional independent benchmark suites remain outside the confirmatory covariance repair.
